generic.intro: Five agents, each limited to the resources it declares it reads. Every answer is built from data you can already consult, and cites its sources.
generic.rule: An unbreakable rule, whichever agent you ask: an answer always cites its source, or admits it found nothing. An agent reads with the permissions of the person asking — it can never surface data that person could not open themselves. The sources shown always come from the retrieval step, never from text written by the model.
